sequence.district_title: Convert between fractions and decimals, day 1.
sequence.target: I can convert a fraction to a decimal by writing an equivalent fraction with a power of 10 in the denominator, and using place value.

homework: Convert Between Fractions and Decimals Practice - Worksheet, due Wed 9/16
sequence.target: I can convert a decimal to a fraction by using place value.

sequence.target: I can build a number line with positive and negative fractions and decimals.

sequence.target: I can order numbers least to greatest; compare with <, >, =

sequence.target: I can differentiate between location on a number line and distance from zero

sequence.district_title: Represent Locations on the Coordinate Plane
homework: finish Sailboat coordinate graphing if not done in class, due Fri 9/25
sequence.target: I can name the parts of the coordinate plane and plot ordered pairs with negative coordinates.

sequence.district_title: Represent Locations on the Coordinate Plane
homework: (continued) finish Sailboat coordinate graphing if not done in class, due Fri 9/25
sequence.target: I can name a point's coordinates, including half units, and explain how points with matching numbers but different signs reflect across the axes.
sequence.classwork: Owl graphing (96 pts). Early finishers: Desmos graphing activity.

sequence.district_title: Find Distances on the Coordinate Plane
homework: (continued) finish Sailboat coordinate graphing if not done in class, due Fri 9/25
sequence.target: I can use absolute value to find the distance between two points that share an x- or y-coordinate.
sequence.classwork: Explore and Share (textbook p. 95); workbook pp. 100–102, problems 9–11, 18–21, 23, 29.

sequence.district_title: Find Distances on the Coordinate Plane
